rows.text: I'd love to make biangbiang noodles with a Xi'an family.
Cycling the Xi'an City Wall at sunset is at the top of my list.
Could someone take me to their favorite neighborhood teahouse in Chengdu?
A quiet hutong breakfast in Beijing sounds like my perfect morning.
I'm fascinated by how the Terracotta Warriors are restored and protected.
Hoping a Chengdu local can teach me mahjong over tea and conversation.
I've always wanted to try Chinese paper-cutting in a family workshop.
My perfect Xi'an morning: a busy market and whatever locals eat for breakfast.
Would love to watch a Peking Opera performer prepare their stage makeup.
Dumplings, family recipes, and stories around the table — that's my kind of trip.
Tai Chi in a local park at sunrise would be an unforgettable start to the day.
I want to learn the brush strokes behind writing my name in Chinese.
Take me through a Chengdu market, then let's cook a proper Sichuan meal.
Could I meet a Beijing kite maker and build one of my own?
Picking tea leaves and seeing Longjing roasted by hand would be incredible.
I'd be thrilled to meet a Xi'an shadow-puppet artist and try the figures myself.
Learning a few bamboo-weaving techniques from a Chengdu artisan would make my trip.
A home-cooked dinner in a traditional courtyard is the memory I want to bring home.
I'd love to slow down, take a local train, and spend the day in a small town.
Just my camera, an old street, and the neighborhood waking up around me.
